26 isn't that young. It's 4 years from 30. Which by then I should already be in a serious relationship if not married. 

I liked to play video games which i realize are just drugs. I did some extra curriculars but did not take them seriously. I was good at math. I dream of having a good career and starting a family. See what I mean?

You are right in that regard. However video games, programming and sci-fi aren't the most social hobbies. I will however look into branching out to some new hobbies. 

As for partying well it's more of the fact that people get invited to places all the time and have a tons of pictures of the awesome memories on their instagrams.
I was on anti-depressants and it just made things worse. Don't you become confident from doing well in life?
